models_evaluated: iCPR (EHR-integrated clinical prediction rule CDS for RN-driven URI visits)

links.outcome: Barriers to workflow fit and adoption of RN-driven CDS across sites (CFIR-coded)
links.effect: Barriers found in all CFIR domains; triage, rooming and documentation workflows varied by institution, and competing duties and RN shortages lowered intervention priority and uptake across 43 practices.
links.quote: Even in a relatively straightforward clinical workflow, workflow and cultural differences appreciably impacted intervention adoption.

screen.reason: Evaluates implementation barriers using the CFIR framework for an EHR-integrated clinical prediction rule (iCPR) CDS tool deployed in 43 practices, but does not test a specific safeguard/deployment practice arm.
